notes.title: Release of Trading Cards, Emoticons & BGs!
notes.notes:
[h3]Friends![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/1b7522ff6a9b91f429a1f62ad286c347f1fe41e2.gif[/img]
[h3]Finally Steam approved our trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges.

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 10 cards, 6 emoticons and 3 backgrounds were added.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/2a60fbbab4538126ea5f90a5aed9c06e72ea970c.png[/img]

[h3]We look forward to your feedback in the comments and discussions![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/d4072946b64273cbb296ebffa8519837632f2d73.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards![/h3]

notes.title: Free DLC Patch to get All Content
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/1118f31e8cb17fde914fd4b32bd15bcc4b72c3b2.png[/img]

[h3]Friends, in order to access all game content, you need to install the FREE DLC Patch. To do this, follow the instructions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/7b0eef5de40e80b5fb1700a634d66631b1b0540d.gif[/img]

1. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293240/House_of_Detention__Adult_18_Patch_FREE/]Go to the patch page (you must be logged in to see 18+ content) - [/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293240/House_of_Detention__Adult_18_Patch_FREE/]link[/url]

2. Add it to your library, download and install

3. Go to the House of Detention page in your Steam Library, click on “Manage My DLC”  and enable the patch - check the box next to it and click “OK”

4. Launch the game, if in the upper right corner you see the choice of the type of monsters - then everything went well![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/482c2da58028eafcc244a2e70d078eca32470cf3.gif[/img]

[i]Dungeon Master[/i]
